name: notes-tasks
title: Notes Tasks
description: Browse the work items of an Obsidian vault task system through its generated JSON index
author: uphy

commands.name: today
commands.title: Today's Tasks
commands.description: Show today's deterministic work candidates, with what is starting soon and what is excluded

commands.name: search-tasks
commands.title: Search Work Items
commands.description: Search every work item by title, project, status and priority, and see what each one blocks

commands.name: top-task
commands.title: Top Task
commands.description: Keep today's first candidate in the menu bar

preferences.name: menuBarDisplay
preferences.title: Menu Bar Display
preferences.description: How much to show next to the icon. The icon alone already carries the state through its colour, and the task name is in the tooltip.

preferences.name: vaultPath
preferences.title: Vault Path
preferences.description: Path to the Obsidian vault holding tasks/. The index is read from tasks/_scripts/.index.json inside it.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
